sources.title: Jev AI Model (TypeSafe) — Typed System One Decisions
sources.snippet: Jev is TypeSafe AI's System One model: it returns a choice, score, or yes/no probability instead of chat. The hosted API is open as of 21 September 2026. $0.042 per 1M input tokens, output free.

sources.title: Jev AI Model Review: Testing 12 Real-World Use Cases - Geeky Gadgets
sources.snippet: Jev AI model testing reveals it operates 20 to 200 times faster than traditional models for classification. See how it handles 12 use cases.

sources.title: Jev: The New AI Model That's Breaking The Internet (Full...
sources.snippet: A new AI model called Jev (referred to as 'Jeff' throughout) is presented as a radically faster, cheaper alternative to LLMs for decision-making tasks. Rather than generating text token by token, Jev outputs classification probabilities, making it 20-200x faster and 40-400x cheaper than frontier LLMs, though it cannot write text, explain itself, or reason step by step.

sources.title: Why Everyone Is Talking About Jev, The AI That Doesn't Chat
sources.snippet: Jev is turning heads with AI decisions that cost pennies and take milliseconds. Could this non-chatting model change how businesses use AI?

sources.title: Introducing System One Models & Jev - TypeSafe AI Blog
sources.snippet: TypeSafe AI is an AI lab building machine-native intelligence infrastructure for automation, designed to make decisions within software. Try our first System One Model, Jev, in early access.
